whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Walk-in Salon,

I noticed your salon has strong 4.5★ reviews at Patna One Mall, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for online appointment bookings.

Maine aapke salon ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp booking, hair & skin service menu, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/walkin

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript:
"Hi Team Walk-in Salon, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke salon (Walk-in Salon at Patna One Mall) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha."

"Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya?"

**Branch A (If they checked it):**
"Great! We tailored it specifically with mobile-first booking, a service menu, and a direct WhatsApp appointment button for clients looking for a salon in Lodipur. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?"

**Branch B (If they haven't checked yet):**
"No problem at all! Direct live link aapke WhatsApp par hai. Whenever you get 2 minutes ek baar open karke check kariyega—koi commitment nahi hai, just wanted to share the idea and get your feedback."

"Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
